title: Tool Builder
hero_prompt: A detailed draughtsman's etching of a craftsman's workbench seen head-on: hand tools hung in careful order on a pegboard, a set-square and calipers, a row of notches carved into the bench edge like a checklist, wood shavings below. Fine engraved linework, blueprint-ink discipline, warm and orderly, darker upper register.
icon_prompt: A bold high-contrast square emblem: a set-square crossed with a hand-forged chisel bearing a guard, over a fine grid. Pure black and white printmaking silhouette, no gradients.
